summary: Scilex Holding Co filed an 8-K to disclose a binding term sheet with Datavault AI Inc. for a $120 million cash contribution in exchange for revenue participation from Datavault's Quantum-Ready Edge Network. The terms include a 30% revenue share up to $250 million, then 15% up to $1.2 billion, then 5% thereafter. No board recommendation or advisors are named. This is a revenue-sharing arrangement, not an acquisition or divestiture. There is no change of control, tender offer, or capital return. The filing is a routine material definitive agreement outside special-situations categories.
